title: Data and plotting scripts for "Gutzwiller Quantum-Classical Embedding for Dynamics Simulations of Correlated Electron Systems"
description: Data shown in all figures of the paper "Gutzwiller Quantum-Classical Embedding for Dynamics Simulations of Correlated Electron Systems", together with the scripts that regenerate the figures. Included are the time-dependent ghost Gutzwiller dynamics of the Bethe-lattice Hubbard model after interaction quenches with exact and AVQDS-propagated embedding states, the single-qubit (B = 1) simulations and IBM quantum hardware results, and the simulated measurement of the embedding observables under a trapped-ion noise model, with the raw results and scripts of these measurement simulations. See README.md for the description of every file.
